stem_book: When the position vector r̄ = xî + yĵ + zk̂ changes sign as −r̄, which one of the following vectors will not flip under sign change? (a) Linear momentum (b) Velocity (c) Acceleration (d) Angular momentum
work: p, v, a are polar (flip with r); L = r × p = (−r) × (−p) = r × p does not flip
